candidates.instruction: Speak in the voice of a very young, cute girl. Your voice should be high-pitched and sweet, full of innocent energy.

candidates.instruction: Adopt the persona of a slightly naughty child planning their next adventure. Speak with a conspiratorial tone, as if you're sharing a fun but forbidden plan.

candidates.instruction: Sound like a confident, energetic tomboy. Your delivery should be direct and maybe a little bit brusque, but not unfriendly.

candidates.instruction: Speak as a very shy and timid girl. Your voice should be soft and quiet, with a lot of hesitation and uncertainty.

candidates.instruction: I need a performance that sounds like a shy girl. Keep your voice quiet and your pacing a bit tentative.

candidates.instruction: Adopt a 'tsundere' persona. Start off sounding annoyed and dismissive, but let a hint of underlying warmth or concern slip through.
candidates.text: You're always getting into trouble, so I figured I should probably see what was going on.

candidates.instruction: Embody the classic 'tsundere' archetype. I want a sharp, almost hostile delivery that barely conceals a softer, more affectionate feeling.
candidates.text: Make sure you actually use this, otherwise there was no point in me bringing it over.

candidates.instruction: Speak with the infectious enthusiasm of a 'sunny boy' persona. Your voice should be bright, cheerful, and full of positive energy.
